newsitem.title: USA: United Security embezzlement cuts earnings.
newsitem.headline: United Security embezzlement cuts earnings.

text.p: United Security Bancorp said over the weekend that it is filing an 8K form with the Securities and Exchange Commission to report embezzlement activities at its subsidiary, Home Security Bank.

"The person allegedly responsible was an operations officer who circumvented the internal control procedures in a highly skilled manner," the company said in a release. "We have strengthened our internal audit controls to ensure this situation cannot be repeated."
The company said the embezzlement would cause an after-tax adjustment of $525,000 that reduces its previously reported 1996 earnings to $3.2 million from $3.7 million.
Insurance should cover the principal portion of the loss, or about 83 percent of the figure, but not the remaining 17 percent, United Security said.
It said added that any insurance payments received would be credited to earnings in the year received.
